name: feega
description: Design in your codebase: click any element of your running app, edit it visually, and the change is written to your code. No AI, no tokens.

feegaInspect.telemetry.description: Send anonymous usage counts (sessions, edits, session length, editor, OS, device kind). No code, no file paths, no IP address stored. Also off when VS Code telemetry is off.

feegaInspect.styling.description: How style edits are written. Auto: Tailwind classes when the project has Tailwind; otherwise CSS in the component style block (Svelte, Vue), or an inline style in files without a stylesheet (JSX, HTML).

feegaInspect.devCommand.description: Command that starts the dev server. Empty: detected from package.json.

feegaInspect.defaultSize.description: Device size the preview opens at.

feegaInspect.keepServerAlive.description: Minutes the dev server Feega started stays warm after the panel closes. 0: stop on close. Closing the window always stops it.

feegaInspect.aiPermissions.description: Default for the AI tab: Ask every time, Allow edits and ask for commands, or Allow all. Each project remembers its own choice.

feegaInspect.notifications.description: Notify when an AI agent needs you while Feega is not in view. Messages name the agent and the project, never code or prompts.

feegaInspect.notifyFinished.description: Notify when an AI agent finishes. Needs Notifications on.

feegaInspect.notifyPermission.description: Notify when an AI agent needs permission. Needs Notifications on.

feegaInspect.routeGenerators.description: Run route generators (entries, getStaticPaths) through the dev server to find example pages of dynamic routes. SvelteKit and Astro. This runs your project code.

feegaInspect.cloud.enabled.markdownDescription: Internal. Turns on Feega Cloud features that are not released yet.

feegaInspect.syncSelection.description: Reveal the source of the selected element in a text editor beside Feega, with its line selected, without taking focus. Coding agents that read the editor selection then see it.

feegaInspect.previewUnknown.description: Show the diff and wait for Apply when Feega cannot tell where an edit will land (global CSS, a class built from props or a function, a CSS variable).

feegaInspect.plugins.dev.description: Folders of plugins you are developing. Each holds a feega-plugin.json and its built entry file. Feega loads them marked dev and reloads them when their files change.
